## Libraries
```{r library}
options(java.parameters = "-Xmx30000m")
set.seed(100)
required_Packages_Install <- c("dplyr", "patchwork", "Seurat","ggplot2","DT","UCell")
for(Package in required_Packages_Install){
  if(!require(Package,character.only = TRUE)) { 
    install.packages(Package, dependencies=TRUE)
  }
  library(Package,character.only = TRUE)
}
```
## Loading data
I've renamed features.tsv to genes.tsv for Read10X() to work.
```{r data loading}
data_obj <- readRDS("/Users/ladislavbucek/Desktop/UK/Mgr./labgenexp/refractory/STAR/refractory-12-hpaSolo.out/data/processed/data_obj_processed.rds")
data_obj_markers <- readRDS("/Users/ladislavbucek/Desktop/UK/Mgr./labgenexp/refractory/STAR/refractory-12-hpaSolo.out/data/processed/data_obj_markers.rds")
datatable(data_obj_markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>% top_n(n = 30, wt = avg_log2FC))
```

```{r dotplot, echo=FALSE, fig.height=10, fig.width = 16.2}
DotPlot(data_obj, features = features_test_s4a) + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5))

# dotplot for every cell type markers from S20
for (group in names(features_test)) {
      markers <- features_test[[group]]
      plot <- DotPlot(data_obj, features = markers) + 
        ggtitle(paste("DotPlot for", group)) +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
      
      # Print each plot
      print(plot)
    }
```

# UCell before annotation
```{r Ucell plots before annotation, fig.height=6, fig.width = 10}
data_obj <- AddModuleScore_UCell(data_obj, features = features_test)

signature.names <- paste0(names(features_test), "_UCell")

#for (group in names(features_test)) {
#    markers <- features_test[[group]]
#    data_obj[[paste0(group_name, "_combined")]] <- rowMeans(
#        FetchData(data_obj, vars = markers),
#        na.rm = TRUE
#    )
#}
    # Create a list of the new combined feature names
#combined_features <- paste0(names(features_test), "_combined")

# Plot the combined UCell scores for each group
for (signature.name in signature.names) {
    plot <- VlnPlot(data_obj, features = signature.name, group.by = "seurat_clusters", pt.size = 0.5) +
        ggtitle(paste("UCell Score for", gsub("_combined", "", signature.name))) +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))
    
    print(plot)  # Print each plot
}
print("works")
```

## Problem with annotating cluster 31
```{r, cluster 31}
# Subset cells from cluster 31 based on metadata
cluster_31_data <- subset(data_obj, subset = seurat_clusters == 31)


# Filter for cluster 31 and extract the 'gene' column
cluster31.markers <- FindMarkers(data_obj, ident.1 = 31)

# Print the markers
head(cluster31.markers)

VlnPlot(cluster_31_data, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)


plot1 <- FeatureScatter(cluster_31_data, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt") +
    scale_y_continuous(                  # Set y-axis range from 0 to 100%
        breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 10),        # Major ticks every 10%
        minor_breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 1)    # Minor ticks every 1%
    )+
    theme(
        panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray",  linewidth = 0.25)  # Display minor grid lines
    )
plot2 <- FeatureScatter(cluster_31_data, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA")+
    scale_y_continuous(                  # Set y-axis range from 0 to 100%
        breaks = seq(0, 15000, by = 1000),        # Major ticks every 10%
        #minor_breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 1)    # Minor ticks every 1%
    )+
    theme(
        panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray",  linewidth = 0.25)  # Display minor grid lines
    )
plot1 + plot2
```
# Cluster annotation
Cluster 1 would be myeloid cells based on S4A but not based on S20 markers
Cluster 16 are maybe melanocytes based on UCell 
but also have low S20 marker expression of melanocytes precursors and muscle cell precursors (same as in melanocytes)
```{r}
levels(data_obj)
head(Idents(data_obj))
data_obj <- RenameIdents(data_obj,
                                  "0" = "basal epidermis (tp63+)",
                                  '1' = "unnanotated 1",
                                  #no myeloid S20 marker
                                  #based on S4 i would annotate as myeloid cells
                                  '2' = "erythrocytes",
                                  '3' = "RICs",
                                  '4' = "basal epidermis (tp63+)",
                                  '5' = "erythrocytes",
                                  '6' = "basal epidermis (tp63+)", 
                                  #changed from RICs to basal epidermis based on S20
                                  #but still have lef1.S expression as RICS
                                  '7' = "RICs", #lower RICs marker exp
                                  '8' = "basal epidermis (tp63+)",
                                  '9' = "goblet cells",
                                  '10' = "myeloid cells",
                                  '11' = "ROCs", 
                                  #lower ROCs marker exp
                                  #but low basal too
                                  '12' = "somites and others",
                                  #changed to somites and others
                                  #from melano precursors
                                  '13' = "notochord", 
                                  #low noto markers exp
                                  '14' = "basal epidermis (tp63+)", 
                                  #or rics
                                  #based on S20 looks more like basal
                                  '15' = "myeloid cells",
                                  '16' = "melanocytes", # not sure
                                  #very low marker exp same as in melanocytes prec or muscle cell prec marker group from S20
                                  '17' = "muscle cells",
                                  '18' = "notochord",
                                  '19' = "MCCs",
                                  '20' = "muscle cells",
                                  '21' = "ionocytes",
                                  '22' = "erythrocytes",
                                  #but marker genes expression at low level
                                  '23' = "goblet cells",
                                  #low goblet S20 markers exp
                                  #maybe basal
                                  '24' = "myeloid cells",
                                  #but low S20 marker exp
                                  '25' = "ROCs",
                                  '26' = "SSCs",
                                  '27' = "neuronal cells",
                                  #changed from MCCs to neuronal based on S20
                                  #but low neuro marker exp
                                  #dont have sncb.L and elavl4.L expression in S4A
                                  #also based on clustering seems like neuronal
                                  '28' = "melanocytes precusors",
                                  #also somites and others markers
                                  #maybe mixed cluster
                                  '29' = "goblet cells",
                                  '30' = "neuronal cells",
                                  #changed from MCCs to neuronal based on S20
                                  #also based on clustering seems like neuronal
                                  '31' = "unnanotated 2",
                                  #high "percent expressed" fgfbp2.L and col9a1-b on dotpllot from S4A
                                  #some erythro markers
                                  '32' = "notochord",
                                  '33' = "myeloid cells",
                                  #missing most of the S20 markers
                                  "34" = "neuronal cells",
                                  #lower S20 marker exp
                                  "35" = "myeloid cells",
                                  #lef1.S expression
                                  #also missing some S20 markers
                                  "36" = "erythrocytes")
#no melanocytes found
```

## Final annotation visualation
melano precursors have somites and others markers expression
RICs markers in MCCs??
melanocytes precfursors do have higher muscle cell precorsors markers exp than muscle cells prec 
```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.height=10, fig.width = 16.2}

levels(data_obj)
# View the metadata

cluster_labels_m <- levels(data_obj)

# Generate a color palette with the same number of colors as there are clusters
cluster_colors_m <- Polychrome::createPalette(length(cluster_labels_m), c("#ff0000", "#00ff00", "#0000ff"))

# Assign each color to a cluster name
names(cluster_colors_m) <- cluster_labels_m

# Generate the UMAP plot with custom colors
DimPlot(data_obj, reduction = "umap.unintegrated") +
    scale_color_manual(values = cluster_colors_m) +
    theme_minimal() +
    ggtitle("UMAP")


for (group in names(features_test)) {
      markers <- features_test[[group]]
      plot <- DotPlot(data_obj, features = markers) + 
        ggtitle(paste("DotPlot for", group)) +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
      
      # Print each plot
      print(plot)
    }

```
